resources.string: Oblivion — an independent Minecraft Bedrock launcher fork
Special thanks to LiteLDev, DreamGuXiang, the LeviLauncher contributors, and upstream dependencies.
Thanks to all sponsors and supporters for the project\'s development!
Oblivion is a downstream fork of LeviLauncher Android and is distributed under Apache-2.0. See LICENSE and UPSTREAM_CREDITS.md for attribution.
Oblivion is maintained independently. Original LeviLauncher credits and notices remain with the upstream project.
Manage the accounts used to sign in to Minecraft
Turn on \"Sign in to Minecraft with Oblivion\" in Settings to manage Microsoft accounts.
